THE WORST GROOMING SERVICE! DONT TRUST THEM WITH YOUR DOG. This is genuinely the worst grooming service I have ever experienced. I would never bring my dog here again.

I was very clear that I wanted my dog’s hair cut as short as reasonably possible. He is a Golden Retriever type, so I trusted that a professional groomer would understand how to handle his coat properly.

Instead, they SHAVED HIS ENTIRE BODY while leaving the hair on his face long. The result looks absolutely ridiculous and completely disproportionate. I was honestly shocked when I saw him.

When I asked why they had done this, their response was simply that “it will grow back in two weeks.” That is not an acceptable explanation for completely ignoring what was requested and giving a dog such an extreme haircut without discussing it with the owner first.

If shaving his entire body was what they believed was necessary, they should have explained that beforehand and asked for my approval. They didn’t.

Terrible communication, terrible judgment, and an incredibly disappointing experience. I trusted them with my dog and deeply regret it. I absolutely do not recommend this place.
Nobody was at the shop, doors locked (although open times said the place is open). Nobody answered the phone or the knocks.

I took my dog, an 8kg Podengo, to have his nails trimmed, and the first two times the service was excellent. But unfortunately, the staff changes frequently, and the last time the service was performed by two completely inexperienced girls without any supervision. I heard my dog ​​yelling during the service, something he doesn't usually do, and I ended up receiving him with only three nails trimmed.

In short, it's not a pet shop with consistent service, and the chance of having a bad experience is quite high.

Your review is already very clear and detailed. Here’s a polished version that keeps your frustration but makes it a bit more structured and impactful:

I am leaving this review because I am extremely frustrated and disappointed with the level of professionalism at this place.

The first time I visited, I left my cat for a wash, brushing, and nail trimming. After an hour and a half, I received a call telling me they couldn’t do anything because my cat was stressed and unhappy, and I needed to come and collect her.

I would expect a business offering grooming services for cats to be prepared for situations like this. Whether it’s having the right equipment, using a protective cone, or having two staff members assist, these are things that should already be in place. They reassured me that if I booked again in the future, it wouldn’t be a problem because they would be prepared.

Three months later, I booked again. When making the booking, I specifically left a note asking whether they were equipped to handle my cat and whether they had everything necessary, knowing that she gets stressed. Nobody replied.

I arrived for my appointment and was told, “Yes, just leave your cat.” Then they informed me that there was a dog downstairs and asked if I could collect my cat an hour later than originally agreed. Not ideal, but I agreed.

I had barely walked away when, thirty minutes later, I received a text message telling me to come back and collect my cat because they didn’t have the equipment needed to look after her.

Seriously?

No solution was offered. No apology. No explanation. Nothing.

This happened twice. Twice they wasted around two hours of my day. It is completely unacceptable and incredibly unprofessional.

It’s very clear that they have no idea how to properly manage cat grooming. If they did, they wouldn’t schedule a stressed cat alongside a dog, they would read the booking notes, and they would confirm beforehand whether they were actually able to provide the service.

There was no manager contact, no phone call, no attempt to make things right—just complete disorganisation and a lack of professionalism.

Avoid this place if you expect competent care for your pet.

The door was locked upon the time that the dog should be ready, nobody was answering the phone, we got worries, after multiple time trying to Knox and calling, with only and actually saying we would call the police if we couldn’t get in and see the dog. The employee was extremely rude, shouted, maked a huge scene, didn’t even finished my dogs bath, was extremely inappropriate and that behaviour is not acceptable, it was THAT BAD.
My dog came home quiet, reclusive and sad, pretty sure she wasn’t treated well, at all.
THIS WAS THE WORST GROOMING EXPERIENCE EVER, you can’t treat customers like that, you can’t treat animals like that.

DONT BRING YOUR DOG HERE
